tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Hille--Yosida Theorem] ↗ def:semigroup-contraction-semigroup ↗ def:semigroup-generator ↗ thm:resolvent-operator-properties 1. ch7:7.4-thm-4\group Semigroup Theory

Let $A$ be a closed, densely-defined linear operator on $X$. Then $A$ is the generator of a contraction semigroup $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$ if and only if \[ (0,\infty ) \subset \rho (A) \text{ and } \| R_\lambda \| \leq \frac{1}{\lambda } \text{ for } \lambda > 0. \tag {17} \]

Proof

\sketch Necessity follows from the Laplace-transform resolvent. Conversely define the bounded Yosida approximants $A_\lambda =\lambda AR_\lambda $ and semigroups $e^{tA_\lambda }$. Resolvent estimates give contraction and Cauchy bounds; their strong limit is a contraction semigroup whose generator is the closure of $A$.

□
